steps.label: Our process
steps.title: Your loan in 3 simple steps
steps.desc: A 100% digital, secure and transparent process to support you from start to finish.
steps.s1_desc: Use our interactive simulator, choose your amount and term, then complete your application online in 10 minutes.
steps.s2_desc: Safely upload your supporting documents (ID, pay slips). Our team analyzes your file within 48 hours.
steps.s3_desc: You are notified by email. In case of approval, you sign electronically and funds are paid within 72 working hours.

personal.title: Personal Loan
personal.desc: Do you need money to finance one or more projects? The personal loan allows you to borrow the desired amount and repay it at your own pace.
personal.sol_desc: At Vantex Bank, you make your personal loan application online and get an immediate decision in principle. In case of acceptance, all you have to do is electronically sign your contract and upload your supporting documents.
personal.sim_desc: Get a precise estimate in seconds.
